zh.askTitle: 换成你们家的搬家时间、预算和孩子学校，吉隆坡的月度开支就按你们的情况重算
zh.runTitle: 香港四口之家搬去吉隆坡：2027 年 8 月起，两位家长远程工作，孩子 6 岁和 9 岁，预算约 18,000 马币/月

fields.label: 金额
fields.value: 每月约 18,000 马币（全家预算）

fields.label: 详情
fields.value: 两位家长都在为香港雇主远程工作

fields.label: 名单
fields.placeholder: 例如：列出你想比较的 3–4 所国际学校

fields.label: 详情
fields.value: 三卧室出租房，考虑 Mont Kiara、Bangsar、Desa ParkCity、赛城/布城、八打灵再也一带

fields.label: 详情
fields.placeholder: 例如：买车，还是用 Grab 加地铁

fields.label: 金额

zh.template: 请为{date}规划吉隆坡家庭预算：税后可花上限{ceiling}，每位家长的职业、收入、雇主注册及护照{parents}，孩子生日及学校需要{kids}，候选学校{schools}，住房及工作位需要{housing}，交通偏好{transport}，落地现金{cash}。分开月度储备、入学收费及可退押金，测试升年级的影响，列出付款前要确认什么。只做规划，不联系、不申请、不预订、不付款。

phases.title: 查当前的租房、学校收费、生活成本和官方签证规定
phases.note: 12 套三卧室在租房源、4 所国际学校的收费表、DE Rantau 远程工作签证与 MM2H 的官方规定
phases.judgment: 签证资料以官方最新版为准：马来西亚数码经济机构（MDEC）2026 年 11 月 1 日发布的第 11 版常见问答，把科技类年收入门槛定为 36,000 美元（非科技类 60,000 美元），而仍能搜到的旧版写的是 24,000 美元，它明确不用旧数字。它还发现官方问答对“配偶能否工作”答的是“不能”，所以结论是两位在职家长要分别评估各自的主申请人签证，不能默认一人主申请、另一人当家属就够。

phases.title: 写给家长看的指南，并整理来源清单
phases.note: 区域取舍、房租、学费、水电网络、交通、保险，以及对照 18,000 马币的月度预算表

phases.title: 核对价格算术、覆盖范围、链接和网页版式
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事认为算术没问题，但指出三处会误导规划：按现行学费算，孩子升一个年级学费档位就变，月支出会从 17,690 升到 18,385 马币，超出预算，所以补了“升年级”压力测试；“落地现金 8–9 万马币”说得比模型实际包含的更完整，改称“已确定的先付款项小计”；另外补上签证批准信的有效期和首次入境办理的限制。

workers: 找并逐条打开 12 套三卧室在租房源，覆盖 Mont Kiara、Bangsar、Desa ParkCity、赛城和八打灵再也，记录租金、面积和是否带家具
找 4 所国际学校官方发布的收费表，算出两个孩子的年度学费，并分开列首年的申请费和押金
读 DE Rantau 远程工作签证的官方规定：收入门槛、家属条件、费用，并对照 MM2H
独立复核指南里的学校、签证和预算说法，对照原始资料逐项检查

en.askTitle: Swap in your own move date, budget and children’s schools and the Kuala Lumpur monthly budget is rebuilt for you
en.runTitle: A Hong Kong family of four moving to Kuala Lumpur: from August 2027, both parents remote, children aged 6 and 9, about MYR 18,000 a month

fields.label: each parent's role, income, employer registration and passport
fields.value: Both parents work remotely for Hong Kong employers

fields.label: school shortlist
fields.placeholder: e.g. the 3–4 international schools you want compared

fields.label: housing/workspace needs
fields.value: A 3-bedroom rental in family areas such as Mont Kiara, Bangsar, Desa ParkCity, Cyberjaya/Putrajaya or Petaling Jaya

fields.label: transport preference
fields.placeholder: e.g. buy a car, or use Grab and the MRT

fields.label: arrival cash
fields.placeholder: e.g. MYR 90,000 in hand on arrival

en.template: Build a Kuala Lumpur family budget for {date}, with {ceiling}, {parents}, {kids}, {schools}, {housing}, {transport} and {cash}. Separate monthly reserves, entry charges and refundable deposits; stress-test progression and identify what to confirm before paying. Plan only; do not contact, apply, book or pay.

phases.title: Check current rentals, school fees, living costs and the official visa rules
phases.note: 12 three-bedroom rentals, fee schedules from 4 international schools, official rules for the DE Rantau remote-worker visa and MM2H
phases.judgment: On visas it went with the latest official version: MDEC’s FAQ v11 dated 1 Nov 2026 sets the tech-role income threshold at USD 36,000 (USD 60,000 for non-tech), while the older version still online says USD 24,000, and it explicitly did not use the old figures. It also found the FAQ answers “No” on whether a spouse may work, so the conclusion is that both working parents should be assessed for their own principal passes rather than assuming one principal plus one dependant covers it.

phases.title: Write the parent-friendly guide and the source list
phases.note: Area trade-offs, rent, fees, utilities, transport, insurance and a monthly budget table against MYR 18,000

phases.title: Check price arithmetic, coverage, links and page layout
phases.judgment: The independent colleague found the arithmetic sound but flagged three things that would mislead planning: at today’s fees, moving each child up a grade changes the fee bands and lifts the monthly total from MYR 17,690 to 18,385, over budget, so a grade-progression stress test was added; the “MYR 80,000–90,000 arrival cash” figure read as more complete than the model supports, so it was relabelled an upfront-commitment subtotal; and the visa approval letter’s validity and first-entry rules were added.

workers: Found and opened 12 three-bedroom rental ads across Mont Kiara, Bangsar, Desa ParkCity, Cyberjaya and Petaling Jaya, recording rent, size and furnishing
Found the officially published fee schedules of 4 international schools, worked out annual fees for two children and separated first-year application fees and deposits
Read the official DE Rantau remote-worker visa rules: income thresholds, dependant conditions and fees, compared with MM2H
Independently audited the guide’s school, visa and budget claims against the original sources
